name: Chukjeneun Ajik Kkeunnaji Anatda
source:
"Some wounds never fully mend. And some memories are never really gone."

'The Festival Isn't Over' is a visual-novel adventure game following a retired war veteran, ISHA's fragmented memories. You, as her companion helps Isha to make choices that will result in bringing her memories back, and further more, change her life.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2946110/The_Festival_Isnt_Over/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“有些伤痕永远无法彻底愈合，有些记忆也从未真正消逝。”

《庆典尚未结束》是一款视觉小说冒险游戏，围绕退役老兵伊莎支离破碎的记忆展开。身为同伴的你将协助伊莎做出抉择，帮助她一步步寻回遗失的记忆，乃至彻底改变她的人生。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2946110/The_Festival_Isnt_Over/]Steam[/url]]
